hypothesis: Updates to the shared continued base can trade preservation against repair even within the same training-source domain; measure actual parameter-step effects before an optimizer change.
selection: First 8192 rows of NumPy default_rng(seed+137) permutation of the existing 50k library; consecutive disjoint batches. Next batch cyclically is the separate training check.
exposure: Training only. Frozen base/preprocessing historical exposure retained. No U/D, metric fitting, centres, new labels or confirmation.
objective: Original increment-normalized mean log1p physical error with differentiable GBCT decoder; no regularization or clipping.
intervention: One fresh Adam step, lr 1e-6, default betas/epsilon, foreach=false; restore original weights before each probe and at completion. Historical optimizer moments unavailable and not claimed.
measurements: actual Adam displacement and first-order group effect
same/check training physical repairs and damage
prechecks: Exact deployed-base replay; differentiable/deployed prediction discrepancy <=1e-5 allowance and zero pass disagreements; gradient identity relative error <=1e-5; exact weight restoration; independent physical recount.
work: 8 independent single-step probes per seed, six group backpropagations each; one GPU worker, one CPU thread, two seeds. No training continuation or candidate exported.
checkpoint: Original weights restored; no selected checkpoint

outcomes.harmful_shared_step: Register a controlled parameter-sharing or direction diagnostic; cosine alone cannot justify PCGrad.
outcomes.consistent_repairs_without_damage: Register bounded base continuation with matched control; still require full protected candidate gates.
outcomes.decoder_mismatch: Suspend gradient interpretation and diagnose the numerical path before changing optimization.
outcomes.inconclusive: Inspect fixed training residual structure rather than a blind loss sweep.
